name: Button Mash
description: The room floods with harmful effects by pressing a magic sigil on a console. Each sigil causes different results. There are six sigils on the console.
disable: DC 40 Arcana (master) to disenchant each sigil (can be done from either side of the reception desk), DC 43 Thievery (master) twice to disable the console (can only be done while behind the reception desk), or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 40) to counteract each sigil; prevent Noph from pressing the buttons by gaining access to the reception desk or other methods
routine:
(2 actions) Noph frantically pecks and stomps on the console, using each action to press a random sigil. Roll 1d6 #pressed sigil to determine which sigil Noph presses. Psychopomps are immune to the effects of these sigils.

1 The area is flooded with holy light, dealing (3d12+19) Vitality Damage damage to each creature in the area (Basic DC 43 Reflex Saving Throw).

2 The area is flooded with unholy darkness, dealing (3d12+19) Void Damage damage to each creature in the area (Basic DC 43 Reflex Saving Throw).

3 The area is flooded with blue flames, dealing (3d10+19) Fire Damage damage to each creature in the area (Basic DC 43 Reflex Saving Throw). On a critical failure, a creature additionally takes 1d10 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

4 A comet streaks through the area, attacking the nearest creature to Noph with a comet Strike.

5 Force tethers sprout from the floor, grasping at intruders. Each creature in the area is Immobilized for 1 round unless they succeed at a Basic DC 43 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

6 Ghostly blue mist surrounds each psychopomp in the area, healing them (3d8+19) Healing Damage{3d8+19} HP and granting them Concealment for 1 round.

generalAbilities.name: Lockdown
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Noph or another creature arms the trap by pressing a sigil on the console

Effect A barrier of force forms from floor to ceiling surrounding the reception desk. The DC to counteract this barrier with Dispel Magic is 43. The trap then rolls initiative.
